on 18
November, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:75870
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13595 of 2023
Applicant :- Indresh Maurya

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Addil. Chief Secy.

Counsel for Applicant :- Dinesh Kumar,Maya Ram Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Maya Ram Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Ms Charu Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.307 of 2023, under Sections 170, 171, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Sarojini nagar, District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 13.07.2023 agianst the applicant and one Soni stating that both the accused persons were roaming around in Lucknow Airport and the applicant was wearing uniform of A.S.I. of C.I.S.F. An forged Identity Card of CISF and a temporary Airport Entry Permit in the name of Asha Chaudhary, which was also found to be forged, have been recovered from the applicant.

Indresh Maurya vs State Of U.P Thru. Addil. Chief Secy. ... on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191783618/
1 4.

entities.text: Indresh Maurya vs State Of U.P Thru. Addil. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is 22 years old innocent person, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

5. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the only allegation against the applicant is of unauthorizedly wearing uniform of C.I.S.F. and recovery of a forged I.D. but there is no allegation that the applicant has infact misused his fake identity or commission of any other offence.

6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
7.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is 22 years old person having no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 13.07.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
